The SGETF Series is a stand-alone media converter that provides an interface between
1000Base-T ports and 1000Base-SX/LX ports, allowing users to integrate fiber optic
cabling into 1000Base-T copper environments. Operating at Layer 1, the physical layer,
data is passed through the converter at line speed, making it ideal for applications SGETF1040-110
where low latency is essential SGETF1013-110
